scope_boundary: No activation or user selection confirmation. Other profile families remain unchanged.

records.heading: Freeze the upstream runtime and supported behavior baseline
records.statement: Record the authoritative upstream revision and supported comparison environment for a strict port.

records.heading: Freeze the upstream runtime and supported behavior baseline
records.statement: For Python source ports, identify interpreter version/build and relevant implementation features in the accepted source baseline.

records.heading: Track every in-scope upstream capability
records.statement: For each in-scope upstream capability, maintain its Rust replacement mapping and independently verified status, explicitly accounting for gaps.

records.heading: Compare upstream and Rust observable results
records.statement: Compare equivalent upstream and Rust observations for each reproducible in-scope behavior and record unresolved or unavailable comparisons.

records.heading: Register and approve deviations from upstream
records.statement: Link each intentional divergence to an explicit approval and affected consumer contract.

records.heading: Register and approve deviations from upstream
records.statement: Classify unresolved divergences as unverified or incompatible rather than verified parity.

records.heading: Contain and test necessary unsafe and cross-language interfaces
records.statement: For each necessary unsafe or FFI boundary, establish and verify its safety, lifetime and ABI contract, isolating the boundary where feasible.

records.heading: Verify distribution and installation cutover
records.statement: Verify supported installation, runtime dependency and launch/invocation behavior when replacing a deployed upstream distribution.

records.heading: Verify distribution and installation cutover
records.statement: When deployment replaces existing state, verify authorized upgrade, recovery and rollback procedures against representative state.

records.heading: Object identity, aliasing and mutation
records.statement: Verify agreed identity and alias-visible mutation behavior for Python objects crossing supported interfaces.

records.heading: Dynamic typing and reflection
records.statement: Verify externally consumed Python attribute, reflection and dynamic type behavior.

records.heading: Dynamic typing and reflection
records.statement: Verify callable signature and invocation/dispatch compatibility at supported Python-facing boundaries.

records.heading: Truthiness and implicit conversion
records.statement: Verify Python truth-testing outcomes at in-scope decision boundaries.

records.heading: Truthiness and implicit conversion
records.statement: Verify Python implicit and explicit conversion outcomes at in-scope interfaces.

records.heading: Numeric range, precision and rounding
records.statement: Verify integer range, division and overflow-equivalent behavior where source integer semantics are exposed.

records.heading: Numeric range, precision and rounding
records.statement: Verify floating-point special values, comparison and rounding where externally consequential.

records.heading: Numeric range, precision and rounding
records.statement: Verify Decimal precision, context and rounding where the upstream uses decimal arithmetic.

records.heading: Unicode, text and bytes semantics
records.statement: Verify in-scope Unicode string operations and code-point semantics.

records.heading: Unicode, text and bytes semantics
records.statement: Verify byte/text encoding, decoding and error-policy behavior at exposed interfaces.

records.heading: Equality, hashing and collection behavior
records.statement: Verify in-scope equality, hashing and lookup-key behavior.

records.heading: Equality, hashing and collection behavior
records.statement: Verify exposed collection iteration and ordering guarantees supported by the agreed upstream baseline.

records.heading: Exception, failure and cleanup contracts
records.statement: Verify externally observable exception categories, propagation, failure returns and contractually exposed messages.

records.heading: Iterator and generator protocols
records.statement: Verify in-scope iterator/generator lazy yield, termination and exception propagation behavior.

records.heading: Context manager and resource lifetime behavior
records.statement: Verify in-scope Python context-management resource lifecycle and exceptional-exit behavior.

records.heading: Imports, modules and dynamic discovery
records.statement: Verify import/module name resolution and failure behavior where consumers rely on Python imports.

records.heading: Installed commands, package entry points and plugins
records.statement: Verify distribution entry points, script commands and invocation contracts.

records.heading: Installed commands, package entry points and plugins
records.statement: Verify declared plugin registration, discovery and loading contracts where supported.

records.heading: Async task lifecycle and cancellation
records.statement: Verify in-scope asynchronous cancellation, timeout and failure-cleanup behavior.

records.heading: Async task lifecycle and cancellation
records.statement: Verify promised task ordering, concurrency-limit and backpressure outcomes under representative load.

records.heading: Threads, processes and synchronization
records.statement: Verify in-scope shared-state synchronization, visibility and race-sensitive behavior.

records.heading: Threads, processes and synchronization
records.statement: Verify interprocess communication, isolation and process lifecycle where the Python baseline uses processes.

records.heading: Python API and extension compatibility
records.statement: Verify supported Python-callable interface behavior using an independent consumer.

records.heading: Python API and extension compatibility
records.statement: Verify binary extension/embedding ABI and lifetime invariants only where compiled interoperation is part of the accepted baseline.

records.heading: Serialization compatibility beyond round-trip preservation
records.statement: Verify externally consumed serialized representations against the source contract, including exact bytes only when those bytes are contractual.

records.heading: Filesystem, environment and subprocess boundaries
records.statement: Verify in-scope filesystem, path, permission and environment-variable contracts.

records.heading: Filesystem, environment and subprocess boundaries
records.statement: Verify subprocess arguments, streams, status codes and lifecycle contracts where invoked.

records.heading: Persisted state and legacy migration compatibility
records.statement: Verify accepted historical Python-era persisted files/configurations are read compatibly.

records.heading: Persisted state and legacy migration compatibility
records.statement: Where migration occurs, verify transformation and available recovery/rollback against representative retained state.
